messages:
claire (people-ops): Quick Q from a manager: can we do a title-only promotion (IC -> Sr IC) with no base pay change? What approvals and payroll flags are required?

ben (eng-manager): Yep asking because team wants recognition now but comp budget waits for next cycle. Need to know if title only needs a packet or just a short note.

natalia (compops): Title-only still needs documentation: manager signoff + short rationale (3 bullets). Use the "title_change" packet type (there's a slim template). CompOps reviews for title inflation risk; if title change implies higher band for future comp it may require calibration.

oliver (payroll): From payroll: if there's no cash change, you still must submit a CSV row with action=title_change so HR/payroll records update. Example: `employee_id,action,new_title,effective_date,packet_id,notes`. This helps benefits/stock systems sync.

claire (people-ops): What about equity or 401k/retirement vesting eligibility that could be tied to title?

retirement-bot: Retirement bot: plan eligibility is based on employment class and hire date, not title. Title-only changes do not reset 401k waiting periods. Equity is handled by CompOps; if title change triggers an offer-level grant, open CompOps ticket.

ben (eng-manager): Edge case: manager wants title change effective last month (backdate). Can we backdate title to align with a product milestone?

natalia (compops): We prefer not to backdate titles. If there is a compelling business reason, attach manager+director approval and note `backdate_approved:true` in the packet. CompOps will evaluate reputational and reporting implications. Some downstream systems (HRIS, payroll feeds) may not accept retro title changes.

oliver (payroll): Technical note: HRIS sync windows run nightly. Retro title changes may not propagate to benefits vendors immediately and could require vendor tickets. For auditing, include `packet_id` so we can trace change in payroll files.

marta (global-hr): For international employees, some countries have statutory reporting tied to job level. If title increases seniority for local law we need local-HR signoff. Please cc local HR in the packet.

ben (eng-manager): Another ask: if we give a one-time recognition payment alongside title change (small non-recurring), what action/fields do we use?

oliver (payroll): Use `action=one_time_recognition` with `amount` and `taxable=true/false` flag. Note: most countries tax such payments. If you want a gross-up, include `gross_up:true` and attach Finance approval. CSV example: `12321,one_time_recognition,150.00,USD,true,PKT-2026-789`.

claire (people-ops): Anything managers should avoid?

natalia (compops): Avoid repeated title-only changes without comp justification; if someone gets multiple title bumps to hit seniority, do a formal leveling packet. Also don’t promise equity or backdated vesting in a title-only note; route to CompOps.

marta (global-hr): Final reminder: if you change title and the employee is on a visa, consult immigration; some visas consider role/salary. Local HR must confirm compliance.

ben (eng-manager): Great. I'll use the slim packet, submit `title_change` CSV row, and only request a small one-time recognition if approved by finance. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
